plan.notes: B.S. Psychology, College of Humanities and Social Sciences. QUARTER SYSTEM — all credits are quarter hours. Built from the official WWU Psychology Major Checklist 2024-2025 (http://chss.wwu.edu/files/2024-06/WWU-Psychology-MajorChecklist%20FILLABLE.pdf). Major = 75 credits, C- or better required: PSY 101 (5); six 200-level (PSY 203 Research Methods [prereq PSY 101 + 44 credits], PSY 210/220/230/240/250 [prereq PSY 101]) = 30; statistics sequence PSY 305 (declared major), 306 (prereq 305), 307 (prereq 203 + 200-levels + 306) = 15; three 300-level (one Block A 310-324, one Block B 334-359, one Block A/B/C 375-378) = 15; two 400-level seminars (WP2, from two different content areas) = 10. GURs modeled as choice slots; QSR satisfied by PSY 305/306/307 statistics sequence. 180 quarter credits total.
